notes.title: Ortus Arena, patch 1.5
notes.content:
Hi all,

Ortus Arena needed an update! And here it is.

Lots of bugs and inconveniences have been solved. And things should now work for all macs as well!

But there are also cool upgrades to the existing content! New multiplayer functionalities and AI Improvements.

Now is the for change and polishing. If you think there are important improvements for us to make, or if you still encounter a bug, don't hesitate to react on the community forum!

New features:

- Better AI on hard levels
- Possible to accept multiplayer matches while playing solo
- Someone-came-online popup
- You can now see the multiplayer opponent's name

Fixes:

- Mac 17 inch install bug fixed
- Stretching mist bug fixed
- Multiple multiplayer match-invite bugs fixed
- AI waterwarrior attack decision bug fixed

See you in battle.
Guido of the Ortus Arena development team

notes.title: Ortus Arena Improvement Underway
notes.content:
Hello warlords of Ortus Arena, 
 
The fellowship of the Ortus development team has gathered and made up a plan for the coming months. Due to some company misfortunes we had put Ortus aside, but this night the five of us have put our hands together to continue to work on it in our spare time: we really believe in this beautiful game, we want to make it great! 
 
Our goal is to create an inspiring platform where strategical gamers can have an intellectual battle with gamerules that are easy to learn, but difficult to master.  
With Ortus we want players: [list] 
[*]to feel pride when having won a tough battle;  
[*]let them live on the balancing edge of aggressive attacks and thoughtful defence;  
[*]discovering and increasing their tactical talents  
[*]to be part of a community with fierce competition, but also were everyone shakes each other’s hand with great respect.   
 [/list]

[list]
The coming period we are going to work on the following: 
[*]1st week of March 2017 we have gotten rid om some bugs like: Ortus [*]doesn’t work on some Macs, abundance of mist on the playground.  
[*]1st week of April 2017 we have made the AI smarter, added functionalities to stimulate online multiplayer battles and gather more online players. 
[*]Onwards from May 2017 we will work on some additional functionalities in Ortus multiplayer like different battle boards (the ones in the campaign), do some small bugfixing.  
[*]During this time we also gather your wishes and advice for improvements. 
 [/list]
Help us by giving feedback and to enlist so we can approach you for some testing. Send a message to info@ortusgame.com or reply in the community 
 
 
Greetings from the Ortus team 
And see you on the battleground.
